bounds.why: melting point 238.5 °C: A semicrystalline bar cannot hold its shape above its melting point.

its own Vicat 230 °C + 5 °C: Vicat softening (a 10 N needle, 1 mm penetration) is reached at or above HDT at 0.45 MPa for an unfilled bar; the highest Vicat the material's own grades publish caps its unfilled heat deflection estimate softly (BVOH's estimate reached 158 °C against its own Vicat of 90 °C). glass transition 80 °C + 10 °C: An amorphous matrix softens at its glass transition; fibres carry a bar only a little further.

Resolved 2026-09-11 against the current IPCON PPA TDS (rev 2025-11): the internal contradiction is gone - the Main Features text says "compatible with AMS or CFS" AND the Recommended Printing Settings table lists "Enclosed-frame (recommended), open-frame, AMS or CFS". Treat this as a manufacturer claim about generic spool/feed suitability only. Official H2C routing and AMS support remain governed by H2C-WIKI / H2C-MANUAL, which are unchanged; do not upgrade the H2C routing on the strength of this TDS.

knowHow.text: Can be used to print bicycle accessories, temperature-resistant and humidity-resistant insulating parts for automobiles, electronics and mechanical equipment, as well as high wear-resistant parts such as gears, slide rails, and shaft sleeves.
ultra-low warping
smooth surface and high precision
excellent moisture and creep-resistant
Compatible Nozzle Material Any common material
Compatible Support Material Itself or support filament for PA
Compatible Printer Type Enclosed-frame (recommended), open-frame
Super Abrasive Resistance: Low friction and self-lubricating, ideal for gears, bearings, and components under constant wear.
Chemical and Heat Resistant: Withstands chemicals and high temperatures, ideal for automotive, aerospace, and industrial applications.
Versatile Industrial Applications: Perfect for prototypes and high-stress parts like gears and bearings in demanding engineering projects.
Automotive and aerospace components Industrial tooling and fixtures High-performance gears and bearings Chemical-resistant parts Functional prototypes requiring strength and precision
Annealable Filament for Enhanced Strength: Annealing enhances durability, reduces stress, and improves dimensional stability for precise, high-performance engineering applications.
Superior Moisture Resistance: PPA demonstrates significantly better moisture handling with a saturated moisture absorption rate of approximately one-fifth of PA6 and other Nylons.
Annealing is not recommended given it can warp the print.
Ensure proper bed adhesion using a PEI sheet or PVP glue coating to prevent warping.
Use an enclosure to maintain consistent temperature and reduce potential warping, especially for larger prints.
Nozzle: High quality metal nozzle, harden steel nozzle is not needed
For complex geometries, consider using soluble support materials compatible with high-temperature printing.
If moisture contamination occurs (indicated by oozing, bubbles, or rough surface finish): (1) Dry in oven at 80-100°C for 4-6 hours (2) Only perform drying when moisture symptoms are present
Compatible with quick-release support materials
